mathematical_result.statement: If an original-coordinate principal 3x3 block B has one diagonal entry equal to zero and D=abs(det B)>0, then the full ambient quadratic form, after arbitrary outside conditioning, has a continuous C0 density bounded by 3*2^(2/3)*D^(-1/3).

premises: original inputs independent with one-dimensional densities <=1
orthogonal rotation of only the other two coordinates is used as a joint-density change of variables, not as an independence claim
outside original coordinates may be conditioned arbitrarily, producing only affine terms
live corrections forbidding arbitrary-joint coarea and pointwise oscillatory decay were respected

peer_result_applied.application: on B_*=2(J3-I3), conditioning X0=x0 leaves Lambda=[[0,2],[2,0]], so sup_t E|4X1X2+4x0(X1+X2)-t|^-1/2 <=64sqrt(2)
